body:
# 📄 QuickMine Plugin Description
QuickMine is a lightweight Paper plugin that automatically mines connected ores when a player breaks one with any pickaxe. Inspired by veinminer mechanics, it’s perfect for survival servers, UHC, or quality-of-life enhancements.

# 🔧 Features:
Automatically breaks adjacent ores of the same type

Works with any pickaxe (no enchantments required)

Fully compatible with Paper 1.21+

Toggleable via /quickmine command

Preserves tool enchantments (Fortune, Silk Touch, etc.)

Supports all vanilla ores, including deepslate and nether variants

# 🎮 Usage:
Players can toggle QuickMine mode on or off using /quickmine. When enabled, breaking an ore will recursively mine all connected ores of the same type, saving time and effort.

# 💡 Ideal For:
Survival servers

UHC and PvP events

Builders and resource gatherers

Players who love efficient mining

# 🧪 Commands:

/quickmine– Toggles QuickMine mode for the player

→ When enabled, breaking one ore will automatically mine all connected ores of the same type

→ Works with any pickaxe

→ Requires permission: quickmine.use

→ /quickmine on to activate the plugin

→ /quickmine off to desactivate the plugin


**developped by _2onepunchman2_**
